blind.description: A low square wooden bin or box constructed from rough wooden planks and corner posts, filled with a mounded pile of faceted dark grey and black coal or charcoal chunks. The wooden frame has a hand-painted brown grain texture, and the coal is modeled as a solid fused pile with sculpted rocky facets.
blind.from_above: A square wooden frame enclosing a clustered pile of dark charcoal/coal rocks.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall (reaching roughly shin-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet square.
